77:def _profile_column_values(values: List[Any], role_names: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
78:    """Compute aggregate quality signals from a sampled column values list.
79:
80:    Returns {null_ratio, distinct_count, sample_n, format_conformance:{role_name: ratio}}.
81:    Values themselves are NOT retained.
82:    """
83:    n = len(values)
84:    if n == 0:
85:        return {"null_ratio": None, "distinct_count": 0, "sample_n": 0, "format_conformance": {}}
86:    null_n = sum(1 for v in values if v is None)
87:    non_null = [v for v in values if v is not None]
88:    distinct = len({str(v) for v in non_null})
89:    conformance: Dict[str, float] = {}
90:    for role in role_names:
91:        rx = _ROLE_TO_REGEX.get(role)
92:        if rx is None:
93:            continue
94:        if not non_null:
95:            conformance[role] = 0.0
96:            continue
97:        hits = 0
98:        for v in non_null:
99:            s = v if isinstance(v, str) else str(v)
100:            m = rx.search(s)
101:            if m is None:
102:                continue
103:            if role == "role.credit_card" and not _luhn_ok(m.group(0)):
104:                continue
105:            hits += 1
106:        conformance[role] = hits / len(non_null)
107:    return {
108:        "null_ratio": null_n / n,
109:        "distinct_count": distinct,
110:        "sample_n": n,
111:        "format_conformance": conformance,
112:    }

21:def compute_class(load_bearing: LoadBearingSet) -> AssertionClass:
22:    """Canon-4 §23.1 parameterless class-computation.
23:
24:    Exactly one parameter — the load-bearing set.  No confidence, no
25:    strength, no weight, no evidence, no score.  Return is the
26:    AssertionClass floor.
27:
28:    Thin-kernel implementation: with zero units the class is
29:    non_factual (Canon-4 §4.1 unmeasured is a first-class value);
30:    otherwise the floor is utterance (Canon-4 §23 'the weakest
31:    load-bearing unit sets the ceiling for the whole').  A future
32:    wave binds this to real unit-class lookup through opaque handles
33:    per Canon-4 §23 'the floor and the class verdict are read-only;
34:    Solva reads them, it never sets or relaxes them.'
35:    """
36:    if not load_bearing.units:
37:        return AssertionClass.NON_FACTUAL
38:    return AssertionClass.UTTERANCE
